notes: India's first purpose-built AI data centre near Indore; 80MW in four 20MW phases, 60,000 GPU capacity at full build-out, liquid immersion cooling (Varuna), PUE 1.1-1.3. Foundation stone laid 23 Oct 2024 by CM Mohan Yadav; DCD reported go-live target Q4 2024, full capacity Q3 2025. Marked construction (started) pending verified operational status; 80MW is planned full build-out. One of five MP projects under state DC investment policy incentives.
